title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: minimum claim, documents deadline and booking a rejection
content:
## Scope

This part of the notice and time bar policy of the Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims product line governs the minimum claimed amount, the deadline for claim documents, the survey report requirement, and the conditions for booking a rejection.

## Policy clause

1. A claim below the product's smallest claimed amount is rejected with the reason below minimum claim.
2. A claim may be rejected for missing documents only after the tier's documents period, in calendar days, has passed since the notice of loss reached the line. The documents deadline is the notice date plus the tier's documents days, counted on calendar dates, and a rejection for missing documents is possible only from the following day. The notice date and the state of the claim file are read from the system record.
3. The documents are complete when the claims department records them so. A survey report is a required document when the claimed amount is above the product's survey threshold, or when the loss is of a kind for which the product always requires a survey report.
4. A rejection may be booked only while the claim's cover is in the open-claim state.
5. A claim is decided once: a claim that already carries a rejection or a settlement approval is not decided again.

## Boundary cases: documents deadline (hypothetical documents period of 45 days)

| Notice date | Documents deadline | Date of intended rejection for missing documents | Judgement |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 June | 25 July | 24 July | Not yet possible |
| 10 June | 25 July | 25 July | Not yet possible (the deadline day itself) |
| 10 June | 25 July | 26 July | Possible from this day |

## Survey report requirement

| Claimed amount above the survey threshold | Kind of loss always needs a survey report | Survey report required by this clause |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Yes | No | Yes |
| No | Yes | Yes |
| No | No | Not required by this clause |

A claimed amount exactly equal to the threshold is not above it.

## Points of judgement

**The documents period has run out but the claims department has recorded the documents as complete. Is a rejection for missing documents open?** No. The documents are complete once the claims department records them so, so they are not missing.

**May a rejection be booked on a cover that is already in the closed-claim state?** No. A rejection is booked only while the cover is in the open-claim state.
